basis: Blender metres, +Z up, -Y forward; local TRS, parent-before-child
interpolation: finite translation lerp and quaternion slerp; no scale interpolation or overshoot; all 25 ordered pairs sampled
countHandling: Immediate 0..4 from shared snapshot, independent of pose progress; no-match requires validated abstained zero-hit completion
dismissal: transient close target then settle neutral; reduced motion closes directly to neutral
reducedMotion: snap latest settled target; no replay on OFF
sweepScope: these five endpoints and nonovershooting pairwise lerp/slerp only; runtime marks excluded and still unbuilt
